Wake is optional and carries no sender, message, conversation, unread count, or timestamp. Android may delay it in Doze, after force-stop, under OEM restrictions, or after provider deprioritization. It never changes sent or delivered state; mailbox and direct retry remain authoritative.
This Google-free build contains no FCM SDK and advertises no native-wake capability. Direct, mailbox, LAN, mesh, and file fallbacks remain available.
Same knobs as kultd\'s flags; stored without secrets in settings.json. Applied when the node next starts (lock, then unlock).
Standard can contact disclosed, replaceable providers. Those operators can observe your network address, timing, and service requests, but not message contents or your contact list.

Private sends optional rendezvous requests through your local Tor proxy. Bootstrap and mailbox operators can still observe their own connections, and this mode does not claim non-collusion between providers.
Sovereign disables directory defaults and optional rendezvous or wake. DHT, user-selected mailboxes, direct, LAN, mesh, QR/file, and sneakernet routes remain available.
